Duomo — Milan, Italy

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

The historic and commercial core of Milan (Piazza del Duomo, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, the main shopping streets). Very safe by the standards of violent or serious crime, heavily policed and busy at almost any hour. The one real, well-documented issue here is pickpocketing targeting tourists in the crowded areas around the cathedral and Corso Buenos Aires — local news regularly reports plainclothes police patrols specifically for this. Normal city-centre caution with bags and phones is the main thing to keep in mind, not personal safety after dark.
